chunks: Al-Sadiq (عليه السلام) left off the siwak two years before he was taken, and that was because his teeth had become weak.

key_terms.السِّوَاكَ: the tooth-stick used for cleaning the teeth
key_terms.بِسَنَتَيْنِ: by two years; two years before

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام) stop using the siwak before his death?
ai.summary: This report states that Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام) stopped using the siwak two years before his death because his teeth had weakened. It preserves a brief biographical detail related to his personal condition and practice.
